challenge.method: Followed rootElement to the ListedLicense and compared its ID, name, deprecation flag, comment and standard header. Tested the later-version and feature-specific readings, reversed suffixes, tag-object SHA substitution and confusion with specVersion.
challenge.results: The header names Version 1.3 without a later-version clause. Its three list placeholders leave the actual designations open. The comment reverses suffix order for the feature-specific alternatives. The root spdxId supplies exact spelling. The creator marker is 3_29_0, while specVersion 3.0.1 identifies the encoding.
